claims: The Pittsburgh Pirates and shortstop Konnor Griffin agreed to a nine-year, $140 million contract extension in April 2026.
Konnor Griffin's contract extension with the Pittsburgh Pirates runs through the 2034 season.
Konnor Griffin is the first teenager in MLB history to sign a $100 million contract.
Konnor Griffin's contract includes no options or opt-outs.
Konnor Griffin's contract can increase to $150 million via performance escalators
